'''Vik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at the [[Mos Shuuta Grill & Cantina]] in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
